verdict.rationale: First-party docs say teams can collaborate in the same Make conversations, leave comments, and edit the generated code at the same time. Files can be shared with others, and multiple chats can run in one Make file, which together cover working on the same project in a shared space. Missing for 10: details on team workspace structure, permissions and roles, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of real-time collaboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my team can work on the same project together in a shared workspace

citations.quote: Collaborate with your team](https://help.figma.com/hc/en-us/articles/38701587731735) in the same conversations, leave comments, and simultaneously modify the generated code
